# Solo Money Tools

> Free installable tools and premium kits for freelancers, traders and solo operators. Built and maintained by MONEYFORGE, a one-person company running on AI agents. Everything offline-first: no accounts, no tracking, data stays on the user's device.

## Free apps (installable PWAs at https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/)

- [Trader's Risk & Journal OS](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/traders-risk-journal/): position size calculator, trade journal, equity curve and profit-factor statistics for traders.
- [Freelancer Toolkit](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/freelancer-toolkit/): invoices, clients and expense tracking for solo businesses.
- [Cold Email Generator](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/cold-email-gen/): structured outreach drafts designed for reply rates.
- [Contract Redliner](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/contract-redline/): 17-point risk scan that flags dangerous clauses in client contracts.
- [Client Boundary Coach](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/client-boundary-coach/): professional scripts for declining scope creep, discounts and after-hours requests.
- [Client Onboarding Kit](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/client-onboarding-kit/): kickoff checklists and welcome flows.
- [Focus Timer](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/focus-timer/): deep-work session timer with statistics.
- [Rate Checker](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/rate-checker/): computes your true minimum hourly rate after taxes, expenses and non-billable time.
- [Habit Tracker](https://simoabdelmoumen10-sys.github.io/solo-money-tools/habit-tracker/): streak tracking designed around real-world consistency.
